Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Age more than 18 years

right.raw_text:
-  Chronic heart failure prior diagnosis, based on signs  [OR] and or symptoms of heart failure, presenting with acute decompensation as judged by the physician to require hospitalization for IV diuretics
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Refusal to participate in the study

left.raw_text: -  Severe renal impairment defined as eGFR<30ml/m

right.raw_text: -  Cardiogenic shock  [OR] or hemodynamic instability judged by the treating physician to be unsuitable to participate
